title: Unit Event — Farewell, My Mask — Episode4 The Dam Breaks

meta.Event Outline: As if losing her computer wasn't bad enough, Mafuyu feels her mother's grip tighten on her life, taking an increasing toll on her mental state. Amid all this, her teacher is due to return the results of a final...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (It was nice to get to work with everyone today after so long...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (But because of that, I wasn't able to go through the section that I planned to. I need to study when I get home...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I also need to review these sorts of problems again. I made too many mistakes on my final...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I have to do better next time...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I'm doing okay.
Is there something you need, Mom?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I hate to interrupt you while you're studying, but there's something I forgot to ask you during dinner.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
No, that's okay.
So, what is it that you need to ask me?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I feel that you should've gotten them back by now.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: No, I haven't gotten them back yet...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, but I should be getting them back soon. Again, the teachers are all very busy with...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
That's strange.
Your teacher told me a different story.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I went over to your school to talk to them today.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: About you and about how you did on your finals...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: How I did on my finals...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Why didn't you tell me sooner...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I did so poorly that...
I was afraid to tell you...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Thank you for being honest with me.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: But I'd really rather you told me these things without hesitating. There's no need to hide anything from me.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I understand that it must've been a little difficult to get a hold of me recently since I've also been busy with things. I'm sorry about that.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
What's done is done...
So, let's discuss your plan moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Yes, since you'll need to study even more to make up for the ground you've lost.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: For the time being, you may want to reduce the time you spend on extracurricular activities.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(Right...
I was thinking the same thing in terms of making up for what happened.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: In that case, I doubt you'll be needing your phone.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Why...?
Because it's a distraction. It'll keep you from focusing.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
No, I'll be fine...
My phone shouldn't affect how I study.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I promise to keep my grades from slipping even further...!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I called your cram school teacher and they told me that you missed class the other day because “you weren't feeling well”...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: From what I recall, you didn't come home until quite late that day.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I understand your desire to spend time with your friends. When I was your age, all I wanted to was go out and do things with them.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: However, those sorts of distractions will prevent you from focusing on your studies...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: At this rate, you may not do very well on your next mock exam... Which means you may not do well on the real thing. If that were to happen...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: You won't be able to make your dream come true.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Yes. You wouldn't want that to happen, do you?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: So, I'll be taking your phone for safekeeping.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: In exchange, I'll give you a phone that can only make calls. You'll still be able to reach me with that.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Don't worry, Mafuyu.
I'll return it to you when it actually becomes necessary.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: So, I'll be taking this from–

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I promise to study and do better! So please! Anything but my phone...! Because without this, I...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Like I just said, this won't do you any good right now. Why can't you see that...?!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: My friends have nothing to do with my grades slipping! That happened because I...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
No, I know that's not true.
Because nothing like this ever happened until recently...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Which means... It's her fault! That Yoisaki girl...!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: How do you know about Kanade?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I felt the need to see what your so-called friend is like...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Does that mean you met her...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Why?
What did you even talk about?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: None of that matters right now.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
No, stop...!
Please, anything but this!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
I didn't mean for this to happen...
I wasn't hoping that your phone would break...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I'll make sure to buy you a new one by the time you've taken your mock exam...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: So, let's both just try to calm ourselves down. For now, you should rest.
